scenes.text: You copy and paste between apps all day. There is a free way to stop.
It is called n8n. You build a workflow: one trigger, then nodes that pass data along automatically.
The AI Agent node is the brain. You connect a chat model, add a tool, and the agent decides what to do.
The beginner mistake is the missing API key. Create a credential first, or the node fails. Skip it and the whole run stops on the first step.
Test with Execute Workflow, read each node's output, then publish it so it runs on its own. Manual test runs do not count toward your quota.
Start tiny: one trigger, one agent, one output. Get that working before you add anything else.
The full walkthrough is on the channel. Comment GUIDE for the step-by-step PDF.
